description: Convenience scripts only. Each app is an independent npm project with its own package-lock.json; there are deliberately no npm workspaces, because Docker, Vercel and EAS all build each app from its own directory.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix kredibble-backend && npm ci --prefix kredibble-admin && npm ci --prefix kredibble-app
scripts.test: npm test --prefix kredibble-backend && npm test --prefix kredibble-app
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix kredibble-backend && npm run lint --prefix kredibble-admin && npm run lint --prefix kredibble-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix kredibble-admin && npm run typecheck --prefix kredibble-app
